1.5.diagnosis: Original groups include every timed detector record (including no_signal records) from target, predictor, and support series. Any active record can extend the rolling group end, so a chain of individually nearby records can connect multi-month periods; predictor-only records can bridge target episodes. The MAUL1-first catalogue below is independent of those records.

maul1_first_rule: Centered 3-hour median of native MAUL1 gage height; trough-to-peak rise >=1.0 native foot; next response starts only after 24 consecutive valid hourly observations retrace at least half of the preceding excursion below its peak (with a 0.25-ft floor). Missing hours and datum transitions split segments; onset at a segment boundary is censored. The <1.0-ft responses at >=0.5 ft are retained as a separate exploratory tier. The rule is selected without predictor outcomes.
